newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - July 18.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories Friday:
* Lucent said it would buy Octel Communications.
* Some people at AT&T are asking why shareholders should expect better results from the current search for a new leader.
* Burlington Resources said it agreed to buy Louisianna Land and Exploration Co.
* Prosecutors in the investigation of the Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp have evidence that certain hospital executives submitted false information to the government.
* Kmart 's troubled Builders Square unit will be combined with another ailing home improvement retailer, Hechinger.
* A day past surging above 8000, the Dow fell 18.11 points.
* Ameritech selected Ammirati Puris Lintas as its new agency.
* Coca-Cola said its earnings rose 25 percent.
* Solomon said its earnings fell in the second quarter.
* Housing starts rose 4.8 percent in June.
* Sears, Roebuck reported a decline in net income.
* President Clinton threatened to go to the World Trade Organization if the European Union tried to stop Boeing's acquisition of McDonnell Douglas.
